targets.query:
from(bucket: "test_results")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_result" and r._field == "passed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.suite, set: ${suite:json}))
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "test_results")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_result" and r._field == "passed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.suite, set: ${suite:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["outcome"])

from(bucket: "test_results")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_result" and r._field == "duration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.suite, set: ${suite:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["test"])
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)

from(bucket: "test_results")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_result" and r._field == "passed" and r._value == 0 and r.outcome == "failed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.suite, set: ${suite:json}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "test", "suite", "branch", "commit"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)

from(bucket: "test_results")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_result" and r._field == "passed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.suite, set: ${suite:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["suite", "outcome"])
  |> count()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["suite"], columnKey: ["outcome"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      suite: r.suite,
      passed: if exists r.passed then r.passed else 0,
      failed: if exists r.failed then r.failed else 0,
      skipped: if exists r.skipped then r.skipped else 0
    }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with run: r.passed + r.failed }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      suite: r.suite,
      passed: r.passed,
      failed: r.failed,
      skipped: r.skipped,
      run: r.run,
      rate: if r.run > 0 then float(v: r.passed) / float(v: r.run) else 0.0
    }))

from(bucket: "test_results")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_result" and r._field == "passed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.suite, set: ${suite:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["test"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "test", "suite", "outcome"])
  |> sort(columns: ["test"])
